title: Zayse-Zergulla language
extract: Zayse-Zergulla is the combined title for the two closely related dialects of Zayse and Zergulla. The division may be more along ethnic or geographic lines than linguistic. It is an Afro-Asiatic Omotic language, and is spoken in the southwestern part of Ethiopia, to the immediate west of Lake Chamo. It is similar to the Gidicho dialect of the Koorete language.
